fca_warning.fallback: Warning: Late repayment can cause you serious money problems. For help, go to moneyhelper.org.uk.
fca_warning.llm_guidance: DO NOT REWRITE. Regulatory risk warning required alongside a consumer credit promotion. source is 'static' deliberately so no content loop can reword, shorten or drop it. Change only on legal instruction, and change the fallback rather than letting a caller override it.

market_context.fallback: Current Market Average for Personal Loans is 7.9%.
market_context.llm_guidance: A market figure, so it GOES STALE. Static and per-site by design: never let a model invent or refresh it. If no maintained figure is available, set it to empty and the line renders blank rather than lying.

rate_environment_note.fallback: This calculator is updated for the 3.75% Base Rate environment.
rate_environment_note.llm_guidance: Also a dated factual claim (see market_context). The original hardcoded '3.75% Base Rate' into the page markup, which is how copy starts lying. Parameterised so it can be corrected in one place per site.

label_amount.llm_guidance: Label for the principal input. Include the currency symbol matching currency_code.

label_rate.llm_guidance: Label for the annual percentage rate input.

label_term.llm_guidance: Label for the loan term input, in years. The script multiplies by 12 internally.

label_total_interest.llm_guidance: Prefix for the total cost of credit. Keep the trailing colon.

label_total_repayable.llm_guidance: Prefix for principal plus interest. Keep the trailing colon.

default_amount.llm_guidance: Starting value for the principal. Chosen per site to be representative of its audience -- it is what a first-time visitor sees computed. toolgolden.py derives its test vectors by scaling these defaults, so changing one re-baselines that tool's golden values.

default_rate.llm_guidance: Starting APR. Keep consistent with market_context or the page contradicts itself.

zero_display.llm_guidance: The pre-calculation placeholder in all three output slots. Must match the currency the script formats in, or the page flickers between two currencies on first paint.

locale.llm_guidance: BCP-47 locale passed to Intl.NumberFormat -- controls thousands separators and symbol placement, NOT the arithmetic. Was hardcoded in the original.

currency_code.llm_guidance: ISO-4217 code passed to Intl.NumberFormat. Was hardcoded in the original. Set with locale, and match zero_display's symbol.
